memory_verse.label: Bible Portion
memory_verse.text: "When all Egypt began to feel the famine, the people cried to Pharaoh for food. Then Pharaoh told all the Egyptians, 'Go to Joseph and do what he tells you.' Now the famine was over all the face of the earth. Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe throughout the land of Egypt. And all the countries came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe everywhere" - Gen 41:55-57 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As the famine bites, the starving people cry out to Pharaoh, and Pharaoh gives them a simple, saving command: "Go to Joseph and do what he tells you." Joseph opens the storehouses, and soon not only Egypt but "all the countries" come to him for bread. The one who was thrown into a pit and forgotten in a prison has become the source of life for a starving world.

What a picture this paints. In a time of desperate need, there was one man to whom all had to come to be saved, one who held the bread of life for the perishing. And the word to all was, "Go to Joseph."

For those with eyes to see, Joseph here beautifully foreshadows Jesus Christ. In a world starving for something far deeper than bread, there is one to whom we must all come to find life. Jesus said, "I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry" (John 6:35). As Pharaoh sent the hungry to Joseph, so God sends the spiritually starving to Christ. And Mary's words at Cana echo Pharaoh's here: "Do whatever he tells you" (John 2:5).

The famine was over all the face of the earth — and so is humanity's deeper hunger for God. There is bread enough in Christ for all who come. Whatever your need, whatever your emptiness, the invitation stands: Go to Jesus, and do what He tells you. In Him alone is the bread that truly satisfies.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Do you come to Christ, the true Bread, for your deepest hunger?
Are you willing to "do whatever He tells you"?
Whom can you point to Jesus, the source of life for a hungry world?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, You are the Bread of Life, and in You alone is true satisfaction. I come to You with all my hunger and need. Help me to do whatever You tell me, and to point others to You. Amen.
